svg.title: Lyre-harp frame - ARCH TEST PIECE - 2 cheek sectors, 7 string-hole panels 4-A and 8 outer panels
svg.desc: 1 user unit = 1mm. ARCH TEST PIECE - 2 cheek sectors, 7 string-hole panels 4-A and 8 outer panels. A slice of the arch, cut to try the finger joints before committing a whole frame: the panels stand between the two sectors exactly as they do in the instrument, 30mm apart. Sector A and sector B are the same part. 3mm ply, slots for a 3mm sheet at 0.13mm kerf, cut to the fit of 0.25. Blue #0000ff engraves, orange #ff8000 cuts the slots first, black #000000 frees the parts.
